_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: VW W12 6.0L (A8 / Phaeton) - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: Manufacturer rating in PS as published, converted to mechanical hp with 1 hp = 1.01387 PS
reference.source: auto.cz 'Motory V12 (1.dil): Volkswagen/Audi W12' (Phaeton 309 kW 550 N·m at 3000 rpm 10.8:1; A8 W12 331 kW 580 N·m at 4000-4700 rpm 10.75:1); automobile.fandom.com W12 engine (450 PS at 6200 rpm, 428 lbf·ft at 4000-4700 rpm, 72 degree banks, 15 degree VR angle); VW SSP 248 (84 x 90.168 mm, firing order 1-12-5-8-3-10-6-7-2-11-4-9)
reference.notes: Connecting rod length 153.0 mm, oil mass and the redline 6600 rpm / limiter 6900 rpm are estimates. The 309 kW Phaeton version (420 PS, 550 N·m) is the earlier tune.
